## Summary

Describe the user-visible behavior and why the change is needed.

## Compatibility

Describe public API, feature, MSRV, protocol, CLI, or Node.js compatibility impact.

## Verification

- [ ] Added or updated deterministic tests
- [ ] Ran `npm run lint`
- [ ] Ran `npm test`
- [ ] Ran the relevant Cargo feature-matrix tests
- [ ] Updated documentation and `CHANGELOG.md` when applicable
- [ ] Confirmed no generated native binaries or secrets are included
